methods.label: Clear denominators
methods.explanation: Multiplying both sides by 6 gives \(3(x+1)-2x=6\). Expanding gives \(x+3=6\), so \(x=3\).
methods.levelReason: The method uses a least common multiple, properties of equality, and Grade 7 linear-equation procedures.
